answer_text: The Treatyy of Viennaa restored the Bourbon monarchy in France and took away territories France had annexed under Napoleon. Buffer states were created: the Netherlands including Belgium in the north, and Genoa added to Piedmont in the south. Prussia gained land on its western frontier and Austria took control of northern Italy. Napoleon’s German confederation of 39 states was left in place; Russia recieved part of Poland and Prussia part of Saxony. The conservative aim was to put back monarchies overthrown by Napoleon and block future French expansion.
